text:
A white robot arm (jointed segments, black cable running along it) stands at upper centre on a light bench top, mounted to a white plate with hex bolts.

In front of its base, on an aluminium extrusion rail, sits a small squeeze bottle standing upright, its body filled with dark teal/blue-green liquid, topped by a light blue nozzle cap that appears closed. Beside it to the right lies a white plate bearing a black-and-white ArUco-style fiducial marker labelled "620".

At lower right, close to the camera, is a larger white plastic bottle upright with a bright red cap/nozzle attached; its contents are not visible. Behind, a dark grey floor and a white perforated tray at upper left.
